summary: P1 acceptance testing — two-path Catalogue + create-new-product flow + Super Admin Product Requests review UI. Backend 6/6 pytest passed (categories: 401 unauth, returns items with slug incl. beverages/bakery/dairy-eggs for CI Delta; master-products search 'lait' case-insensitive works and returns matches; product-request create → admin list → admin approve (creates master product + auto-links supplier at cost) → supplier sees status='approved' with created_master_product_id; admin reject with notes returns status='rejected'). Frontend verified end-to-end: (1) Delta supplier login → dashboard OK; (2) Catalogue page renders both CTAs [data-testid=catalogue-add-btn] ('Add existing master product') + [data-testid=catalogue-new-product-btn] ('Create new product') + [data-testid=catalogue-two-path-help] info banner; (3) Add-existing modal opens, typing 'lait' returns 7 master-product rows; (4) 'Create new product' click navigates to /martbaked/delta/portal/product-requests with existing pending 'Bhujia · Prabhat Namkeen' card present; (5) 'New request' opens form, category dropdown populated with 9 real categories (Boissons, Boulangerie, Bébé, Fruits & Légumes, Ménage, Produits Laitiers & Œufs, Snacks, Soins Personnels, Viande & Fruits de Mer) sourced from /api/supplier/me/categories; (6) Fill+submit → POST /api/supplier/me/product-requests returns 201, new card appears with status 'pending' and toast 'Product request submitted'; (7) Super Admin login → /admin/modules/mart/suppliers/product-requests renders AdminSupplierProductRequests with 2 pending, 1 approved, 1 rejected buckets; Review drawer → Approve form → category select → Approve & create → POST returns 200 with master_product_id, toast 'Approved — master product ... created', row moves to Approved bucket.

integration_issues.issue: Race condition: if the user clicks 'New request' before the initial /supplier/me/categories fetch resolves, the form opens with an empty dropdown (only the 'Select category…' placeholder). The categories load lives in the parent PortalProductRequests component's `load()` (Promise.all([reqs, cats])). If categories still hasn't set state when the form mounts, the child NewRequestForm receives categories=[]. Reloading the form (close+reopen) shows the full list. Not a blocker for the acceptance flow (user can wait ~500ms) but should be hardened: either disable the 'New request' button until categories load, or have NewRequestForm re-fetch on mount, or show a loading spinner on the dropdown. Reproduced once during automated test with immediate click; on second run with a 2s wait, 9 categories loaded correctly.

action_items: MINOR: Harden the /portal/product-requests page against the categories fetch race — either disable [data-testid=prod-req-new-btn] until `categories` state is populated, show a spinner in the dropdown, or move the categories fetch into NewRequestForm on mount. Current UX works if user pauses briefly after page load; automated/fast clicks may see an empty dropdown.

OPTIONAL: In AdminSupplierProductRequests approve form, `approve-category` prefill is empty when the supplier request has no proposed_category_id — this is expected (form defaults to r.proposed_category_id||''), but consider surfacing a hint like 'Category not provided by supplier — pick one to approve'.
critical_code_review_comments: PortalProductRequests.jsx L22-36 — `Promise.all([reqs, cats])` awaited but the render doesn't gate the 'New request' button on `categories.length > 0`. Race in production: on slow networks the modal can open with an empty select. Non-blocking but worth a 1-line guard: `disabled={!categories.length}` or a `loading` state.

PortalProductRequests.jsx L107-134 — Form only requires `proposed_name`; the P1 spec says required fields include category_id, EAN, manufacturer, pack_size, cost_price, currency. Consider making category/cost `required` in HTML validation to match the spec. Currently backend accepts a request with only name+optional category, and admin approve later demands a category — better UX to enforce at submission.

portal_routes.py L734-796 admin_approve_request — good validation: rejects if proposed cat is missing AND payload.category_id missing (400). But if request.status != 'pending' returns 409 — verified. `net_qty=None` hard-coded because Numeric column vs string proposal is a pending schema mismatch (documented in code comment). Nice.

portal_routes.py L412-431 list_master_products — search only over MartProduct.name/sku_code, not brand or ean_upc. Acceptable per spec ('name OR sku'), but consider extending to `brand` and `ean_upc` for supplier UX.

AdminSupplierProductRequests.jsx L58 — categories fetched from `/mart/categories?country=CI` — HARDCODED country. This will break for non-CI suppliers when SHOP/EXPRESS or other-country suppliers are onboarded. Should derive country from the active request's supplier.country when opening the drawer, or fetch categories per supplier country on drawer open.

success_rate.frontend: 8/8 acceptance items pass on happy path; 1 race-condition (categories dropdown) noted as minor UX polish

rca of the issue: Categories dropdown-empty race: PortalProductRequests.load() fires Promise.all([GET /product-requests, GET /categories]) on mount. React state updates are async; if the user clicks [data-testid=prod-req-new-btn] before the setCategories() microtask flushes (window: ~50-300ms on preview), NewRequestForm renders with the empty parent state via props. React does NOT re-render the form when the parent's `categories` prop later updates unless the form re-mounts. Fix: either (a) `<button disabled={!categories.length}>`; (b) hoist fetch into NewRequestForm; (c) key the form on categories.length so it re-mounts when categories arrive.
